from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import Literal

# The 6 categories are explicitly named in the task, making them safe for Literal.
CauseOfAction = Literal[
    '与公司，证券，保险，票据等有关的民事纠纷',
    '行政行为-行政强制',
    '侵权责任纠纷',
    '行政行为-行政处罚',
    '行政行为-行政监督',
    '行政主体-劳动和社会保障行政管理（劳动，社会保障）'
]

class DocumentInfo(BaseModel):
    """Extracted information from a single judgment document relevant to classification."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The official title of the judgment document (e.g., '《判决文书1》')")
    category: CauseOfAction | None = Field(description="The cause of action as classified into one of the 6 provided categories")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregated parsed information from the collection of documents."""
    documents: list[DocumentInfo] = Field(description="List of all parsed judgment documents")
